title: Job Alerts daily research report (schemaVersion 1)
description: One dated research report. camelCase contract shared by scripts/validate.py, scripts/build_site.py and SCHEMA.md. Unknown keys are rejected at every level; private/internal content (candidate data, contact details, local paths, non-public URLs) is forbidden anywhere in a report.

date.description: Report date; must match the file name YYYY-MM-DD.json.

requestedCount.description: Optional: how many roles the day's search targeted.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the day's result.

coverage.description: How far the bounded search reached.

criteria.description: Hard gates applied on the report date.

job.description: One examined role. Statuses describe checks on the report date, not live availability.

id.description: Slug unique within the report; used for anchors, never as a path.

status.description: qualified = passed every stored gate on the report date; rejected/near-miss are research leads, never recommendations.

applyUrl.description: HTTPS application URL, or null when none was recorded.

checked.description: Date the listing evidence was checked.

posted.description: Employer posting date, or null when unpublished.

locationQuote.description: Recorded location/attendance wording from the listing.

reasons.description: Gate notes: why an entry passed or failed. May be empty.

gates.description: Stored results of the historic hard gates, recorded on the report date. Qualification is judged from these stored values, not from thresholds recomputed at publish time.

product.description: Recorded product/role context note, or null when none was recorded.

financials.description: Recorded company research note, or null when none was recorded.

lower.description: Published numeric floor in `currency`, or null when unknown (never 0 as a placeholder).

upper.description: Published numeric ceiling, or null when unknown.

currency.description: Currency exactly as published; no conversion is stored or implied here.

annualBase.description: true only when figures are confirmed annual base pay; null = unconfirmed.

equity.description: Explicit equity/stock option offer; null = unknown, not false.

quote.description: Recorded research note of the employer's published pay wording (may be a paraphrase, not necessarily a verbatim quotation), or an explicit statement that none exists.
Evidence note: a recorded research note from this source. It may paraphrase the source and is not guaranteed to be a verbatim quotation.
